function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT period,
       SUM(qty * unit_price_orig) AS usd_value,
       SUM(amount_cad) AS cad_amount
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
WHERE currency='USD' AND period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY period","purpose":"Get USD value and CAD amount for USD purchase lines in Aug and Sep"}
